items.title: 68091_Joe Turner oral history interview
items.q: Duke Ellington, he sent for me, told me to come to California. He want me to be in his show.

ctx.x: I used to go down here every Monday mornin'. He laugh and talk with me...he tell me he gonna get me fixed up with a good job 'n' ever'thing. So be an' everythin's gonna be all right. We gonna make a picture. So, everybody seemed to be runnin' off leavin' me in New York City, goin' to ...comin' to California and makin' a picture.

So, one day I got a telegram. He sent it down to the nightclub-- down at Barney Josephson's place. Duke Ellington, he sent for me, told me to come to California. He want me to be in his show. So I told Barney Josephson. He didn't want me to leave so I told him, I said, "I go out there and do his show, and I'll come back."
